entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What is this attack!? One of mankind's...[n]deadly sins!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't let your guard down until we[n]know what it does!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He's doing a different attack! A different[n]deadly sin... What's this all mean?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Another one!? It looks like this is how[n]his main body attacks...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He may keep switching up his moves![n]Let's be careful!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It grew an arm!? And it has a gun!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: As long as it has extra arms, we'll keep[n]getting attacked. We should destroy[n]them all first!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Another one!? Does it have a bell...?[n]Be careful—we have no idea what[n]it'll do!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A sword this time? Getting hit by that[n]would be dangerous for sure...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This one has a book! Don't let your[n]guard down!

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: Rebels who dare defy my rule.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: ...You shall perish.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It regenerated!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Looks like we're gonna have to take[n]down the main body first...!

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: I release upon you the deadly sin of[n]lust.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: You have no means of escape, humans.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: The insanity of mankind shall bring[n]forth the demise...

entries.en: The ingratitude of mankind shall bring[n]forth ruin...

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: The abyss of the unconscious yearns[n]for ultimate ruin...

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: You have no means of escape, humans.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: Punishment shall strike you all...

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: As you pass through the gates of[n]destruction...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Huh? What's this spike in energy!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Some kind of insane attack's coming![n]Watch out!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm getting a reading... coming from[n]the arm.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Its arm is gathering energy!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You might wanna do something about[n]the arm, ASAP!

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: So... this is the power that resists ruin...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Did we do it...!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...No, not yet!

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: My control shall not bow down to ruin.

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: My control is the ultimate truth of[n]this world.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Everyone!

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: The children of men... are all sinners!

entries.speaker: Yaldabaoth
entries.en: In the name of absolute control...[n]you shall fall into ruin.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can't... be beat like this!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If we lose...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I need to... get back up...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: No... No more...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I can't move...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Is there nothing we can do...?
